browser.method: Actual optimized Next.js app and native Chromium Audio/AudioContext; Date.now acceleration only for long event/timer boundaries. Delayed cancellation/404 cases use controlled network routes; callback regression uses the real React panel in a temporary bundle.

baseline.observations: Normal stop/pause/replay/resume continued to allow future events in targeted baseline checks. Permanent mute was not reproduced. The prior callback-dependent activation effect defect was already fixed in a695d5f. The UI still failed to distinguish current audio stop from paused/waiting audio; the new state machine and brief feedback clarify this. This report does not assert the entire temporary baseline audit passed.

fixes: Explicit current cue lifecycle independent of future event eligibility
Stop cancels current WAV, chime and pending cue ticket only; pause cancels audio and freezes clock; resume starts clock without replaying interrupted audio
Shared cue selection cancels an auto chime and its delayed WAV before replacing audio; future events continue
